svg.title: Large-ship routes in Alaska run the Inside Passage, Cook Inlet, Prince William Sound, and Unimak Pass, but shore receivers miss the lanes far offshore

cc:Work.dc:title: Large-ship routes in Alaska run the Inside Passage, Cook Inlet, Prince William Sound, and Unimak Pass, but shore receivers miss the lanes far offshore
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of Alaska. Blue route cells follow the Inside Passage in Southeast Alaska, Cook Inlet to Anchorage, Prince William Sound to Valdez, and Unimak Pass near Dutch Harbor; gray cells show patchy traffic near shore. Few cells appear far offshore.
